name: Community Hub
author: Resonant Alpha
description: Public community hub: check in to see community events (RSVP + live attendance), claim community tasks, and share presence. Shared state lives in a hosted serverless backend; the add-on is the local client, reached through the local bridge.

surfaces.label: Community Hub
surfaces.description: Events feed, community task board, and presence strip for the shared community.

surfaces.label: Events
surfaces.description: Upcoming and past community events with RSVP and live check-in.

surfaces.label: Community Tasks
surfaces.description: Open community tasks members can claim and mark progress on.

surfaces.label: Presence
surfaces.description: Opt-in presence strip showing who is around and what they are working on.

grantPresets.label: Community Hub standard
grantPresets.description: Enable the Community Hub to reach the shared community backend, notify on events, and accept delegated community tasks.

connectors.name: Community API
connectors.description: Connects the add-on to the hosted serverless Community backend (events, tasks, check-ins, presence). Base URL configured per install; per-user token held in the host vault.

workflowBoundaries.label: Public community hub
workflowBoundaries.jobToBeDone: Let anyone browse community events and tasks, and let signed-in members RSVP, check in, claim tasks, and share presence against one shared backend.
workflowBoundaries.userValue: Members see when the community is hosting events and what tasks are open, from inside ResonantOS, without a separate app.
nonGoals: Server-to-client push as a dependency (polling only)
Writing community data into trusted Living Archive knowledge pages
Automated real-world actions such as emailing attendees or handling payments

tools.name: community.list_events
tools.description: List community events with RSVP and attendance counts (public read).

tools.name: community.rsvp
tools.description: Set the signed-in member's RSVP state (going / interested / no) for an event.

tools.name: community.checkin
tools.description: Record live attendance check-in for the signed-in member during an event window.

tools.name: community.claim_task
tools.description: Claim, un-claim, or mark progress on a community task for the signed-in member.

tools.name: community.set_presence
tools.description: Set or clear the signed-in member's opt-in presence status and note.

tools.name: community.report
tools.description: Report an event, task, or presence entry for moderation.

notes: Agents may surface and update community tasks that map to GoalWorkspace steps.
All agent-initiated writes are human-approval gated.
